findings.basis: n=24 stride=9; every sampled replacement starts with the warm banner, is shorter than its original, and its original is untiered

findings.claim: Harness pruner excluded from plugin totals
findings.basis: replacement texts carrying the pruner marker inside the window: 0; the 4 non-TE replacements are system/message re-renders and a compaction checkpoint, classified "other"

findings.claim: Quantified: cost of dropping the pruner rule
findings.basis: in-window: 0 rewrites / 0 chars would be wrongly counted (no pruner-text replacement exists here). Whole-corpus it matters: 180 of 1135 all-time surface replaces carry the pruner marker.

findings.claim: No rewrite after the d1547b9 floor era has charsBefore < 3700
findings.basis: below3700=0 min=3719. The first in-window rewrite is 08:17:59, i.e. 29.9 min after the 07:48:05 commit and 53.8 min after START; no rewrite exists between START and 08:17:59, so the window cannot contain pre-commit TE activity

the floor bounds the INPUT, not the output: inflation stays structurally possible and did occur in 2 post-floor ops that are NOT TE (system/message 42231->55650 and 54095->48116, +26491 chars total), plus one harness blanking 55633->0

findings.claim: Window boundary handling correct (event.time epoch ms; KST only buckets)
findings.basis: first 2026-11-02 08:17:59 (+53.8 min), last 2026-11-05 04:39:07 (-165.0 min); none on an edge; 11-05 is a partial day ending 07:24 KST

findings.claim: No duplicate snapshots, no session double counting
findings.basis: 114 session dirs, 114 non-bak snapshots, 0 dirs with >1. Keyed by (project, sessionId, replacement seq) so a multi-snapshot dir could not double count anyway
1 dir carries *.bak* (session-ec259449-1f09-); selector requires the name to start with session.v4.jsonl.zstd AND excludes "bak"
originals that are themselves replacements: 0; originals rewritten twice: 0. Sum(charsBefore) equals the sum over distinct (session,src) pairs
191 (session,ms) groups, largest 2; each has a different replacement seq and a different original

findings.claim: Every dedup pointer is genuinely TE dedup
findings.basis: 4 exact pointer events, 4 verified by recomputing SHA-256 of the referenced step tool/result. Whole-text equality rejects 2 extra pattern hits that merely QUOTE the pointer inside a JSON report. SHAPE CORRECTION: the pointers DO carry a surfaceOp, but it is the string "append" with sourceEventSeqs pointing at the first occurrence - not an object with op:"replace". A replace-only scanner therefore sees 0 pointers; the BRIEF categorization is right but the field shape differs from a tiering rewrite

findings.claim: The 1 TE rewrite whose ORIGINAL contains the pruner wording is not a pruner rewrite
findings.basis: session-edeabe91 seq 2625 / src 220: the phrase appears inside a quoted measurement report the tool printed ("179 rewrites in 7 sessions"), not in a pruner-produced surface. Classified by the replacement text, so it stays te-warm and is correct
